caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser or chest with a rectangular form and a single drawer at the bottom. The dresser is rendered in shades of green and brown, with the top surface and the edge above the drawer showing light brown wood grain. The main visible surfaces of the chest, including the front and sides, feature a dark green marbled or wood-grain pattern with swirling and linear motifs in even darker green or black. The drawer at the bottom of the front face has two round knobs, colored brown with red accents, and a continuation of the green marbled pattern. The dresser sits on four short legs, with the left side having a decorative cut-out at the bottom edge. The overall perspective is angled, showing the top, left side, and front of the dresser. The background is a plain, light beige color without any other objects or details.
title: Painted Wooden Chest
